title: 항공 LiDAR 7,000회: 출신 × 판단 영역 × 목표 반폭

definition.counterfactual: original r6 Euclidean 0.5m query on r7 valid target points; original r6 targets also shown as separate reference
definition.floating_pixels: project first-hit floating patch centres to saved training views; require depth agreement <=0.25m and alpha>1e-5; unique pixels per view; exact saved argmax alpha*T Gaussian; counts plus unavailable mapping
definition.dominance: mean rendered contribution across visible first-hit correspondences >=0.5; ties by background/released/patch channel order; mixed and unavailable explicit
definition.width: target patch halfwidth=1.96sigma; bins [0,.1),[.1,.5),[.5,1],(1,inf); no valid target is unavailable
definition.area: sum frozen patch area, evaluate ranges only; 0~3 and full eligible reported

note: 각 묶음 왼쪽 빗금 r6 · 오른쪽 r7 · 반폭 1.96σ (m) · 칸 0~3 평가 넓이 · 혼합·확인 불가 별도
